The set forms a clean foundation, while the long coat provides essential protection against the cold weather likely to be on your way there. The bucket bag adds a touch of professional ease, and the shoes keep your stance steady and grounded throughout the meeting.\",\"how_to_wear\":[\"Wrap the coat around you with the belt tied at the waist to define your silhouette and create a smooth vertical line for the interview setting.\",\"Drape the scarf loosely around your neck, allowing it to rest gently near your collarbones, which adds a soft focal point that balances the structured lines of the coat and set.\"],\"wrong_photos\":[],\"swap\":{},\"about_items\":[{\"n\":\"#347·11\",\"text\":\"This set gives you a ready-to-wear foundation that looks neat and put-together for a formal interview, so you can focus entirely on your conversation rather than adjusting layers.\"},{\"n\":\"#131·42\",\"text\":\"The long coat ensures you stay warm as you walk to the bank while its belted cut defines your waist, adding structure and height to your overall silhouette for the camera.\"},{\"n\":\"#548·35\",\"text\":\"A bucket bag is an understated choice that fits the formal atmosphere of a bank interview while offering easy access to your documents without appearing overly casual.\"},{\"n\":\"#605·35\",\"text\":\"These shoes keep your steps steady and grounded, ensuring you look confident and stable as you navigate the office environment.\"},{\"n\":\"#393·28\",\"text\":\"A kerchief worn at the neck adds a refined detail that breaks up the solid tones of the outfit, drawing attention to your face with a hint of colour or pattern that complements your overall look.\"}]}"}],"usage":{"input_tokens":6132,"output_tokens":382},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
